import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import toplamsal as to
In [2]:
I = plt.imread("../data/line-01.png")[:, :, :3]
I = np.mean(I, axis=2)
J = to.radon(I)

plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))
plt.subplot(1, 2, 1)
plt.imshow(I)

plt.subplot(1, 2, 2)
plt.imshow(J)

plt.show()
